skill.name: session-template
skill.description: Apply task-specific planning templates for feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, and security sessions using ai-update-plan.
skill.summary: Apply structured templates to create clear AI session plans for common software tasks.
skill.author: Atyantik

content.value_statement: AI coding sessions often lose structure when tasks change or grow. This skill applies task-specific templates so Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can build a clear plan.
actual_capabilities: Selects feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, or security templates from task language.
Expands selected templates into phased checklist plans.
Customizes generic checklist items with task-specific details.
Shows how to update session plans with ai-update-plan commands.
Supports combined and custom templates for complex work.
Requires project documentation review before applying templates.
limitations: Requires compatible session tooling for best results.
Does not execute plans or verify code changes by itself.
Template choice depends on task wording and may need human correction.
Examples assume the ai-update-plan workflow is available.

use_cases.title: Start Feature Work
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan for research, tests, implementation, quality checks, and documentation before building a new feature.

use_cases.title: Guide Defect Repair
use_cases.description: Structure a bugfix session around reproduction, root cause analysis, regression tests, implementation, and release notes.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Security Fixes
use_cases.description: Use the security template to plan impact analysis, vulnerability tests, hardening work, and final security review.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Basic Feature Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the feature template for this task: <task>. Customize each phase for this repository.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Bug Fix Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the bugfix template for this issue: <issue>. Include reproduction, root cause analysis, tests, and documentation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Templates for Complex Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use for work that crosses task types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the security template, then add refactor steps needed for this change: <task>. Keep phases clear and task-specific.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Session Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use for repeated team workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a custom template for <workflow>. Use phases, checklist items, quality gates, and update-plan guidance.

output_examples.input: Apply the feature template for adding OAuth2 authentication.
output_examples.output: A phased plan covering research, TDD tests, implementation, refactoring, quality checks, documentation, and final review.

output_examples.input: Apply the bugfix template for a memory leak in the data processor.
output_examples.output: A repair plan that starts with reproduction, traces root cause, adds a failing regression test, fixes the issue, and validates quality.

output_examples.input: Apply a security template for an authorization bypass.
output_examples.output: A security plan covering impact analysis, vulnerability tests, least-privilege fixes, hardening, security testing, and disclosure notes.

best_practices: Read project documentation before selecting a template.
Customize each checklist item so it names the relevant code, docs, or risk.
Remove irrelevant steps and add missing validation before implementation starts.
anti_patterns: Applying a template without checking current project context.
Keeping generic checklist items that do not match the task.
Treating the generated plan as fixed after new findings appear.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning instructions and examples for session tools.

faq.question: Which templates are included?
faq.answer: It includes feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, and security templates.

faq.question: Can I combine templates?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes multi-template planning for complex tasks.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare the task description and read the project documentation requested by the skill.

faq.question: Is it only for Python projects?
faq.answer: No. The templates are general software workflow checklists, though examples assume repository tools.
